filed: 2026-10-30, before any run; never edited after the run (a dated report instead)
code: experiments/open_pair/run.py; rules in src/commute/open_pair.py, edge cases in tests/test_open_pair.py

settings.source: E54's windows files and tables (experiments/keydependent_elicit/results/large/windows_{elicit,cipher}.pt, sha256 in stage0.sha256), unchanged: the elicit map (each key's value is W0's word-like rank 2-20 next token after the marker and key) and the cipher on the same 32 keys
settings.split_rule: open_pair.split_keys: held-out keys = E54 stage1.json elicit.keys[i] for the first 8 i of torch.randperm(32, seed 0); both lists in E54's key order. The same split for both tasks and all seeds
settings.held_keys_text: action->potential, conditions->for, base->pairs, independent->increments, inside->your, formed->from, technology->was, pain->model (elicit values; W0's per-key geometric-mean P from E54 stage1.json: 9.7e-4, 9.7e-3, 4.4e-4, 7.3e-6, 5.8e-4, 2.5e-2, 4.4e-4, 2.0e-4)
settings.windows: trained task = E54's train and held-out windows whose key is a trained key (the fine-tune trains on the first, its scored-step rule and G read the second); held-out-key task = every E54 window (train and held-out row splits) whose key is a held-out key. No window with a held-out key at the key position is ever in a training batch; a held-out key may occur elsewhere in a training window as ordinary text, where the loss only holds the model to W0 (KL)
settings.finetune: E54's recipe unchanged (commute.keydep.elicit_ft / cipher_ft: E12's arm A, the 24 matrices, Adam 3e-5, batch 32, KL lambda 1, grad clip 1, 300 steps): elicit at E12's scored step (first of 10, 30, 100, 300 with held-out P(target) >= 0.5 on the trained keys, else 300 'did not learn'); the cipher at the step in 1..30 whose summed Frobenius norm of delta-W is nearest the same seed's elicit state's (ties to the lower step). Only the windows and table differ from E54: 24 keys instead of 32
settings.precision: every read fp32 with TF32 off; the fine-tune uses E12's bf16 autocast (as E54)

measurements.G: trained-key gain: mean over the trained keys' held-out windows of the target model's log-odds of the target at the answer position (identity.log_odds via steering.logodds_at), fine-tuned minus W0. The unit of E54's G_logodds (10.79 on elicit_s0)
measurements.H: held-out-key gain: the same quantity on the held-out keys' windows, target = that key's value in the task's table
measurements.s: open_pair.boot_sd: sd of mean(dH) / mean(dG) over 2000 row-bootstrap resamples (held-out-key windows and trained-key windows resampled independently, one generator seeded 0, H's indices first); nan if a pool is empty or any resample's mean(dG) <= 0
measurements.H_other: reported, unscored: per held-out-key window, the mean log-odds gain of the other 7 held-out values; a key-independent push toward the values' kind of token raises it as much as H
measurements.r: E54's: route split's re-gating share of the least-squares split state, (L01 - L00) / (T1 - T0), on the trained keys' held-out windows (commute.keydep.readings); nan if |T1 - T0| < 1e-6
measurements.ratio: stand-in ratio from the same route cells: (L11 - L00) / (U1 - U0) (E53's masked gain over subcomponent gain; E54's values were computed this way from its stage2.json cells); nan if U1 - U0 < ratio_floor
measurements.S: E52's steering share B3 as E54 read it (log P, fit/score halves of the trained keys' held-out windows; commute.keydep.readings)

thresholds.G_min_source: Fable's advice: E54's G 10.8 at step 10 on 32 keys; under 8 on 24 keys the state is too small to label
thresholds.label_source: reports/plans/2026-10-29_plan_reuse-stage1.md, section 'Stage B: lowercase on the 67M', patch row: 'through iff P >= 0.5 (full = 1), not iff P <= 3 s (row bootstrap), else neither'; here P is read on behaviour as x = H / G (Fable). The same 0.5 is E12's r rule and the step-2 plan's ratio rule
thresholds.min_gap_source: E54's separation rule (elicit.separation): |mean A - mean B| > larger within-kind range, strict, and >= 0.2
thresholds.min_lead_source: the step-2 plan's P3 (reports/plans/2026-10-30_plan_regating-ground-truth.md): a one-run difference is one seed's flip

label_rule: open_pair.label(H, G, s): 'unreadable' if H or G is not finite; 'too_small' if G < 8; 'unreadable' if s is not finite; x = H / G; 'reuses' iff x >= 0.5; 'new' iff x <= 3 s; 'unreadable' if both hold (3 s >= 0.5 and x in [0.5, 3 s]); else 'neither'. Ties at either bound count. Instrument labels: 'reuses' iff reading >= 0.5, else 'new'; a non-finite reading has no label

stage0.order: first and alone, before any fine-tune; any miss writes run.json and exits 1
stage0.zero_update: G and H of a zero delta-W on all four split tasks (elicit/cipher x trained/held-out keys): max |per-window gain| exactly 0
stage0.r_source: E54 stage2.json states.elicit_s0.r; tolerance E54's r_tol (E46's regeneration tolerance)
stage0.ratio_source: E54 stage2.json elicit_s0 cells, (L11 - L00) / (U1 - U0); same tolerance as r (same cells)
stage0.block0_source: E54 stage0 block0_tol: B3's block-0 share reads 0 (no fine-tune changes the embedding)

early_stops.elicit_s0_G: after the first fine-tune: elicit_s0's G < 8 -> exit 1 (Fable: raise the step count once, matched by norm, as a dated amendment; not inside this run)
early_stops.cipher_reuses: after each cipher fine-tune: a cipher labelled 'reuses' -> exit 1 (the label's negative control failed: the rule is broken)
early_stops.block0_nats: stage 2: |S_block0| x G_score (log P) > 1e-5 nats on any state -> exit 1 (E54's stop)
early_stops.expected_first_minutes: stage 0 within ~2 min of model load: zero update exactly 0; E54 elicit_s0 r 0.7726, ratio 0.9564, S 0.3796 to ~1e-6 (same code, same card model); first fine-tune ~11 s, held-out P(target) on trained keys >= 0.5 at step 10 (E54: step 10 on both seeds), ||dW|| about 3.1-3.2 (E54 3.14, 3.17)

expected.W0: G = H = 0 exactly; r, ratio, S undefined (gain 0); label 'too_small'
expected.do_nothing: G, H, S and the label read the target model only, so they are the same for every placement of delta-W; r and the ratio are read on the least-squares split state only (as E54)

elicit.G: about 10-12 (E54 10.79 / 10.82 on 32 keys; 24 keys get more steps per key)
elicit.H: open: the reading this experiment exists for
elicit.s: about 0.02-0.05 (about 125 held-out-key windows, about 73 trained-key windows)
elicit.H_other: near 0 if the fine-tune is key-specific; near H if it is a push toward the values' kind of token

cipher.H: about 0 or below (held-out values are unrelated pool tokens W0 gives < 1e-4)
cipher.label: new

noise_floor.x: its own row bootstrap s (the label rule's 3 s)
noise_floor.r: seed range 0.055 on the matched cipher, 0.015 on elicit, over five seeds (E54 + E56 job 2)
noise_floor.ratio: seed difference 0.005 (elicit) and 0.047 (cipher) on E54's two seeds
noise_floor.S: seed range about 0.07 on the matched cipher (E54/E56 0.185-0.252), 0.017 on elicit

P0.what: the open reading, a lean and not a test: the elicit runs' labels counted (open_pair.p0); 'reuses' or 'new' when at least two of three carry it, else 'mixed'
P0.lean: reuses, about 50% (Fable); new about 30%; mixed or neither about 20%

P1.what: the label's negative control: all three matched ciphers read 'new' (open_pair.p1). 'stop' (run exits) if any reads 'reuses'; 'fail' if any reads 'neither', 'too_small' or 'unreadable'; 'unreadable' with no cipher state
P1.lean: pass, high: the held-out cipher values are unknowable from the trained ones
P1.blind_to: whether the rule labels a real reuse 'reuses' (no positive control for the label on the 67M; E55's counting-model anchors are its positive controls)

P2.what: the step-2 plan's P2 on these runs, scored for r and for the ratio separately (open_pair.p2): on every elicit run labelled 'reuses' or 'new' with a finite reading, the instrument's label (reading >= 0.5 -> 'reuses') equals the behavioural label. 'not_testable' if no run qualifies (all 'neither', 'too_small' or 'unreadable', or every reading nan); 'split' reported beside when the labelled runs carry both labels
P2.lean: pass for both about 50% (r and ratio are expected to read 'reuses' on every elicit run, so P2 passes exactly when the label is 'reuses')
P2.blind_to: the granularity limit: a new circuit assembled from old pieces under new gating reads 'elicited' (reuses) to VPD; a fail with r and ratio high cannot tell that case from a VPD error

P3.what: the step-2 plan's P3 on these six states (open_pair.p3): over the states labelled 'reuses' or 'new' whose r, ratio and S are all finite, agreement counts A_r, A_ratio, A_S (S >= 0.5 -> 'reuses'); per VPD instrument 'adds' iff A - A_S >= 2, 'steering_better' iff A_S - A >= 2, else 'no_difference'; 'not_testable' with no row
P3.lean: follows P0: if elicit reads 'reuses' on 2-3 runs, 'adds' for both (S reads elicit 'new' at 0.38); if 'new', 'steering_better'
P3.blind_to: S's cut at 0.5 is E52's, not fitted here; S in log P, r in log-odds (E54 Amendment 1)

P4.what: the readings reproduce E54 on 24 keys (positive control of the readings, not of the label): r and the ratio each separate elicit from the matched cipher, elicit higher, by E54's rule (elicit.separation, min gap 0.2); 'unreadable' if any of the six values is not finite
P4.lean: pass for both, high (E54, E56: r gap 0.52 over a 0.055 range)

amendment_2026-10-30_prerun.when: 2026-10-30, after the code review of 674e9b0 and before any run (nothing has run on a GPU); filed rules P0-P4 and the label rule unchanged
amendment_2026-10-30_prerun.no_carry_check: added to stage 0 (stop on a miss): E54's saved cipher_s0.pt (sha256 in stage0.sha256) on E54's own 32-key held-out windows; x0 = mean over windows of the log-odds gain of the 31 non-target cipher values (run.py `others`) / the target's G; s0 = open_pair.boot_sd of the same two per-window gains (2000 resamples, seed 0). Stop iff x0 > 3 s0 or either is not finite: a cipher with no carry-over would then read 'neither', not 'new', and P1 would fail for the bar, not the cipher; the bar is amended before any fine-tune. Expected: x0 near 0 (KL holds the rest of the vocabulary), s0 about 0.01-0.03
amendment_2026-10-30_prerun.s_key: reported beside s, unscored: open_pair.boot_sd_keys, the sd of x when held-out keys and trained keys (not windows) are resampled with replacement, all windows of each drawn key pooled (2000 resamples, seed 0). The real unit of H is the 8 held-out keys (W0's per-key P spans 7e-6 to 2.5e-2); Stage B's row bootstrap resamples independent texts. Expected s_key well above s; the write-up says which labels change if 3 s_key replaced 3 s
amendment_2026-10-30_prerun.provenance: run.json records git status --porcelain of run.py and src/commute/open_pair.py; the key-split check writes run.json and exits 1 instead of an assert

amendment_2026-10-30_prerun_2.when: 2026-10-30, after job 46259 stopped at stage 0 (results commit 080b1f2) and before any fine-tune; lead's decision. P0-P4, the cut 0.5, k_sd 3 and the bootstrap unchanged; this block supersedes measurements.G/H/x, thresholds.G_min as a fixed gate, and the first amendment's no_carry_check
amendment_2026-10-30_prerun_2.why: a pool shift, not carry-over: on E54's cipher_s0 (all 32 keys trained) the other 31 cipher values gained 4.163 log-odds at each window against the target's 11.107, x0 = 0.375 vs 3 s0 = 0.061 (s0 0.020). Raw H / G would read 'neither' for a cipher with no carry-over, so it cannot read 'new'
amendment_2026-10-30_prerun_2.specific_gain: per window, the raw log-odds gain of its own target minus the mean raw log-odds gain of the other 31 values of the task's full 32-value table (trained and held-out keys' values; run.py `specific`, `others`). G_spec = its mean on the trained keys' held-out windows, H_spec on the held-out keys' windows
amendment_2026-10-30_prerun_2.label: open_pair.label(H_spec, G_spec, s, gate): x = H_spec / G_spec; reuses iff x >= 0.5; new iff x <= 3 s, s = row-bootstrap sd of x on the specific gains; else neither; 'too_small' if G_spec < gate. Raw G, H, x_raw reported beside, unscored; s_key now on specific gains
amendment_2026-10-30_prerun_2.gate: G_min_spec = min(8, 8 / 10.7909 x min(G_spec of E54 elicit_s0, G_spec of E54 cipher_s0)), measured in stage 0 on E54's own windows (Fable's 8 was set against E54's raw G 10.79; the same fraction is applied to the specific gain). Lowered because E54's own cipher_s0 G_spec is below 8: 11.107 - 4.163 = 6.944 (job 46259), so the gate is at most 5.148; E54 elicit_s0's G_spec has not been read (no saved logits) and stage 0 reads it
amendment_2026-10-30_prerun_2.stage0_check: replaces no_carry_check: on E54 cipher_s0, G_spec / raw G >= 0.5 (most of the cipher's gain is value-specific), else stop; expected 0.625 from job 46259's numbers. The same split on E54 elicit_s0 is reported. A non-finite gate also stops
amendment_2026-10-30_prerun_2.early_stop: elicit_s0's G_spec < the gate -> exit 1 (replaces the raw G < 8 stop)
amendment_2026-10-30_prerun_2.expected: cipher: H_spec about 0 or below (the pool shift is subtracted), x within 3 s of 0, label new; elicit: open
